facts.fact: Dr Bawumia, then NPP flagbearer and Vice-President, said the Ghana Health Service, Births and Deaths Registry, Ghana Statistical Service and National Identification Authority systems had been integrated so that children 0-13 get a Ghana Card number from 17 June 2024.
facts.system: Ghana Card number for children (NIA, BDR, GHS, GSS integration)

GHA.note: No count or share of people holding the ID is given.

facts.fact: Dr Bawumia said that from 17 June 2024 all basic-school children would start to receive Ghana Card numbers, and that the integration of the health service, births registry, statistics service and NIA would give every child aged 0-13 a unique identity number linked to the parents' identity.

GHA.note: Nothing stated on who operates or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.
Nothing stated on the system's biometric checks or certification.
No statement on local civil registration offices entering events digitally.
